## Description

Simulate region/database loss in staging: restore SQL (PITR/geo-restore in-country), Blob, Key Vault, app config and queued jobs; measure RPO and RTO; update runbooks.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Measured RPO ≤ 15 min and RTO ≤ 4 h with timestamps recorded.
- [ ] **AC2.** Queued jobs (reminders, AI, integrations) resume without duplicates after restore.
- [ ] **AC3.** DR runbook updated and reviewed.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
